address: Herdade das Valadas, N4, Montemor-o-Novo, 7050-031, Portugal
bio: It offers great comfort and surprises by virtue of its location in the heart of the Alentejo countryside, in the splendid, modern hotel L’AND Vineyards Relais & Châteaux. Chef David Jesus, who decided to take on this project after stints at major establishments such as the two-Michelin-starred Belcanto (Lisbon), champions a creative cuisine with traditional foundations, drawing on his personal experiences and memories. His offering, mostly enjoyed by the hotel’s guests, is presented in an à la carte format and through two tasting menus: Expedição (Expedition) in 7 moments and Caminhos (“Paths”) served in 11 moments, inspired by the chef’s experiences of Portuguese travels and the flavours of its former colonies.
